$comment: §4.1c mutation coverage for every rendered verdict in this lab.
One entry per data-verdict marker. A mutation counts as a KILL only when the
unmutated baseline PASSED in the same run, the failure is that verdict's OWN
assertion (not a build error, a blank page, a timeout, or the whole suite
going red), and the run served the mutated code. mutations/run.mjs enforces
all three; it runs with CI=1 so playwright.config.ts's
reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI is false and no stale server on port
4667 can answer for an unmutated checkout.
e2e/verdicts.spec.ts fails if the page renders a marker this file does not
cover, and fails if this file claims a marker the page never renders. A
marker reachable only on a failure path carries rendersOnlyUnderMutation:
true, and the spec then requires it to be ABSENT from the healthy page, so
the flag cannot be used to hide a verdict that really does render.

mutations.grep: KAT strip verdict follows the measured vectors
mutations.why: Corrupts the FIPS 197 C.1 expected vector so one of three KATs fails. The strip must then say 'Known-answer mismatch' with data-state='fail' and 2/3.
mutations.scope: Also reddens claims.spec.ts's negative-claim test, which legitimately asserts green KATs; the kill is recorded from the marker's own test via --grep.

mutations.grep: headline advantage and ledger are independently consistent
mutations.why: Severs the IND-CPA verdict from the measured Wilson interval. Textbook RSA with re-encrypt wins every trial, so the verdict must read BROKEN: ADVANTAGE.

mutations.grep: negative claim survives green KATs and two misleading flat lines
mutations.why: Pins the negative-fixture headline to its placeholder so two genuine flat lines no longer promote it to the 'AND THE SCHEME IS BROKEN' form.

mutations.replace:
const schemes = await createSchemeRegistry();
    throw new Error('mutation: forced scheme-registry failure');
mutations.grep: healthy boot renders no engine-failure verdict
mutations.why: Forces the catch branch that paints the engine-failure verdict, proving that banner is reachable and that the healthy-boot assertion can see it.
mutations.scope: Exhibit 01 never initializes, so this mutation is panel-global by construction; the marker's own test races the two outcomes so the failure is an assertion, not a timeout.

mutations.grep: exact CCA challenge is refused and hidden panels stay unpainted
mutations.why: Makes the oracle-boundary verdict stop reporting the real byte-comparison refusal; it must flip to BOUNDARY FAILURE.

mutations.grep: CCA2 verdict follows the measured interval
mutations.why: Severs the CCA2 verdict from its measured interval. ElGamal malleation wins every trial, so the alarm branch is the only correct one.

mutations.grep: forgery verdict follows the real verifier outcome
mutations.why: Inverts the EUF-CMA verdict's tone branch, so a real textbook-RSA forgery renders as a pass and a refused RSA-PSS alteration renders as an alarm.

mutations.grep: ECDSA values reconstruct the accepted high-S twin
mutations.why: This is the mutation that exposed the original defect: the plain verifier now REJECTS the (r, n - s) twin, collapsing exhibit 03's whole point. Before this lane the banner was a literal and all ten claims stayed green while the page rendered 'PLAIN VERIFIER: ACCEPTED' beside a computed 'rejected'.

mutations.replace: return secp256k1.verify(signature, message, publicKey, { lowS: false });
mutations.grep: ECDSA values reconstruct the accepted high-S twin
mutations.why: Drops canonical low-S enforcement, so the 'library default' verifier accepts a high-S signature. The banner must follow it to ACCEPTED; the test decides the expected outcome from arithmetic on the displayed s, not from the page.

mutations.grep: switching verdict follows the measured rows
mutations.why: Severs the sampler verdict from the measured rows, so the banner cries SAMPLER CHECK FAILED while every displayed row sits inside bound + tolerance.

mutations.grep: reduction verdict follows the measured factor
mutations.why: Severs the reduction verdict from the measured Adv(B) vs Adv(A)/2 comparison, so it reports RELATION OUTSIDE while the displayed numbers agree.
